evidence.quote: We assume a gravitational potential model for the MW, MWPotential2014 (Bovy 2015)

notes: All stars listed in Table 1 (T:p4-b0) are treated as candidates_found: the authors select a 30-star extreme-velocity sample satisfying E > 0 or the stated marginal-binding threshold in MWPotential2014 and report a P_unb for each (T:p2-b9). Gaia-T-ES25, Gaia-T-ES26, Gaia-T-ES27, Gaia-T-ES28, Gaia-T-ES29, and Gaia-T-ES30 have E < 0 but meet that explicit marginal-bound criterion and belong to the same sample. Although the final discussion favors a more massive MW in which the stars would be bound (T:p1-b5, T:p8-b10), it still states that in MWPotential2014 their space velocities imply unbound status (T:p9-b4); candidacy is therefore retained conditionally. The LMC, MWCenter, and stream origin tags are not used as evidence of unbound status. Gaia-T-ES14 and Gaia-T-ES15 are kept as separate stars because the paper only suggests they might be debris of the same system/stream (T:p4-b0, T:p7-b1). Gaia-T-ES5, Gaia-T-ES6, Gaia-T-ES7, Gaia-T-ES10, Gaia-T-ES11, and Gaia-T-ES15 overlap Marchetti et al. (2018) but are not classed as follow_up because this paper independently selects and analyzes the 30-star sample. Other previously known HVS candidates are only cited or plotted and are not individually analyzed here.

Gaia-T-ES1: Target Gaia-T-ES1 (Gaia DR2 3252546886080448384) is the first row of Table 1 (T:p4-b0). The table reports Galactic longitude/latitude rather than RA/Dec and does not list parallax or proper motions, so those quantities were not extracted. The tabulated v_r = -337.0 km/s is a Galactocentric radial velocity, not the heliocentric/barycentric line-of-sight velocity, so it was not used for radial_velocity; the tabulated v_los = 1.7 km/s was used instead. Bound probability is not directly reported; only P_unb = 0.95 is given.

Gaia-T-ES3: Table 1 at T:p4-b0 gives Gaia-T-ES3's Galactic longitude/latitude, heliocentric distance, Galactocentric radius, total velocity, Galactocentric radial velocity v_r, Gaia line-of-sight velocity v_los, energy, angular momentum, and P_unb. The paper does not report equatorial right ascension, declination, parallax, or individual proper-motion components for this star; only its Gaia DR2 source_id is listed. I treat v_los = -219.7 km/s as the radial_velocity and do not use v_r = 552.6 km/s, which is the Galactocentric radial velocity. The table's r = 7.8 kpc is recorded as the galactocentric_radius.

Gaia-T-ES4: In T:p4-b0, Table 1 gives Galactic longitude and latitude rather than equatorial RA/Dec, and does not list individual parallax or proper-motion components for Gaia-T-ES4. The table's v_r is a Galactocentric radial velocity, so it is not used as the heliocentric line-of-sight radial velocity; the v_los value is used instead. P_unb = 0.85 is explicitly the unbound probability in MWPotential2014; the paper does not report a corresponding bound probability for this star.

Gaia-T-ES5: Target Gaia-T-ES5 = Gaia DR2 5212817273334550016, identified in T:p4-b0. Table 1 provides Galactic coordinates l,b rather than equatorial RA/Dec, and it does not provide individual parallax or proper-motion components for this star, so those quantities are omitted. The table's v_r is a Galactocentric radial velocity and is not recorded as radial_velocity; the heliocentric line-of-sight v_los is recorded instead. P_unb is reported directly, but no bound probability is reported, so bound_probability is omitted rather than derived.

Gaia-T-ES6: Table 1 reports Galactic longitude l and latitude b, not equatorial RA/Dec; no parallax or proper motions are reported, so those quantities are omitted. The table's v_r is a Galactocentric radial velocity and is not recorded as the requested heliocentric radial_velocity; the v_los value is recorded instead. P_unb is the probability of being unbound in MWPotential2014 and is not converted to a bound probability because no bound probability is separately reported.

Gaia-T-ES7: At T:p4-b0, Table 1 lists v_r = -572.7 km/s separately from v_los = -8.2 km/s. The text and Figure 3 identify v_r as a Galactocentric radial velocity, so it is not recorded as radial_velocity; the heliocentric line-of-sight v_los is recorded instead. Table 1 gives P_unb = 0.88 and does not explicitly report a bound probability. The Origin entry is "-" (no Galactic Center, LMC, or stream association identified).

Gaia-T-ES8: Table 1 gives Galactic longitude and latitude rather than equatorial RA/Dec, and it does not report individual parallax or proper-motion components for Gaia-T-ES8, so those quantities are omitted.
